defaultPriceUsdPerMChars.source: Public translation API rates 2017 (Google Cloud Translation: $20 per million characters)

workP100h.source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.03762 §5.2: base model, 8 P100 x 12 h = 96 P100-hours
Game-design estimate: a larger production translation model, about 4x the base paper model

checkpointEveryH.source: Game-design choice: a checkpoint every 4 hours

researchContractFactor.source: Game-design choice: an active research contract takes half of the lab's own GPU time

start.source: Didactic curve shape, not paper data: loss span above the floor at 0 % progress

exponent.source: Didactic curve shape, not paper data: how fast the loss falls

floor.source: Didactic curve shape, not paper data: loss at 100 % progress

everyWeeks.source: Game-design choice: consulting offers arrive every 4 weeks

maxOffers.source: Game-design choice: 0 to 2 offers per round

usdMin.source: Game-design choice: smallest consulting gig for a 2017 AI lab

usdMax.source: Game-design choice: largest consulting gig for a 2017 AI lab

usdStep.source: Game-design choice: gig values are rounded to this step

weeksMin.source: Game-design choice: shortest gig, in weeks

weeksMax.source: Game-design choice: longest gig, in weeks

minReputation.source: Game-design choice: reputation needed before a compute grant is offered

p100eq.source: Game-design choice: 500 cloud V100 hours modelled as 2.5 P100-equivalents of virtual GPU

hours.source: Game-design choice: cloud V100 hours granted

weeks.source: Game-design choice: weeks the grant stays open once accepted

bankruptcyNegativeWeeks.source: Game-design choice: consecutive weekly settlements ending with negative cash before bankruptcy

replicatePaper.source: Game-design choice: reputation reward for replicating the paper

translationV2.source: Game-design choice: reputation reward for the translation v2 model
